name: Online Bibles
description: Download Bible translations (public-domain Bibles hosted by OpenSanctuary, ChurchApps, Bolls.life, public GitHub repositories) and look up passages online, into your Bible library.

permissions.reason: Appears as a panel in the console
The server fetches Bible catalogs, whole translations and single passages from these hosts on the plugin's behalf, and from no others
Adds the downloaded chapters to your Bible library. Downloading a translation again replaces its chapters, so this can also replace chapters of a translation you already have
Adds a looked-up passage to the schedule
